Aluminium is extracted from bauxite by electrolysis.
Which statement is correct?
A
Aluminium ions are oxidised to form aluminium.
B
The cathode has to be replaced regularly because it reacts with the oxygen which is formed.
C
Carbon dioxide is produced at the anode.
D
Cryolite is added to remove impurities.

options.label: A
options.text: Aluminium ions are oxidised to form aluminium.

options.label: B
options.text: The cathode has to be replaced regularly because it reacts with the oxygen which is formed.

options.label: C
options.text: Carbon dioxide is produced at the anode.

options.label: D
options.text: Cryolite is added to remove impurities.
